qualification.details: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government or State Government or Union territory Administration or recognized research institutions or Universities or public sector undertakings or semi-Government or statutory or autonomous organisations; (a)(i) Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years' regular service in the post in level 10 in the pay matrix 56,100-1,77,500 or equivalent; Bachelor's Degree with Economics or Commerce or Business Studies or Statistics or Mathematics as the main subject and five years' experience in work related to jute marketing or statistical analysis and research work in a Government organisation; or; Master's Degree in Economics or Commerce or Business Studies or Statistics or Mathematics with three years' experience in work related to jute marketing or statistical analysis and research work in a Government organisation Experience: Five years (with Bachelor's Degree) or three years (with Master's Degree) in work related to jute marketing or statistical analysis and research work in a Government organisation Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Must be holding an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service in Level 10 (56,100-1,77,500) or equivalent in parent cadre Candidate must be able to be spared to take up the assignment within one month from the date of intimation about selection Departmental Assistant Director (Marketing) in Level 10 with five years' regular service and the prescribed qualifications will be considered along with outsiders; selection deemed promotion

how_to_apply: Fill the application in triplicate in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I of the circular.
Enclose cadre clearance, attested APAR photocopies of last 5 years, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance and penalty / No Penalty certificate.
Get the application verified / countersigned by the Head of Office or an authorised officer and forwarded by the Cadre Controlling Authority.
Send it through proper channel to the Deputy Jute Commissioner, Office of the Jute Commissioner, Patsan Bhawan, CF Block, 7th & 8th Floor, Action Area-1, Newtown, Kolkata-700 156.
Subscribe the envelope "Application for the post Deputy Director (Marketing)".
Application must be received within 17th November 2026; late, incomplete or applications without documents will not be considered.
important_instructions: Officials who volunteer for the post will not be permitted to withdraw their names later on Applications received after the closing date, without the listed documents or otherwise incomplete will not be considered Application must be submitted in triplicate Employer must certify that the candidate will be relieved immediately if selected

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government or State Government or Union territory Administration or recognized research institutions or Universities or public sector undertakings or semi-Government or statutory or autonomous organisations; (a)(i) Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years' regular service in the post in level 10 in the pay matrix 56,100-1,77,500 or equivalent; Bachelor's Degree with Economics or Commerce or Business Studies or Statistics or Mathematics as the main subject and five years' experience in work related to jute marketing or statistical analysis and research work in a Government organisation; or; Master's Degree in Economics or Commerce or Business Studies or Statistics or Mathematics with three years' experience in work related to jute marketing or statistical analysis and research work in a Government organisation Experience: Five years (with Bachelor's Degree) or three years (with Master's Degree) in work related to jute marketing or statistical analysis and research work in a Government organisation Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Must be holding an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service in Level 10 (56,100-1,77,500) or equivalent in parent cadre Candidate must be able to be spared to take up the assignment within one month from the date of intimation about selection Departmental Assistant Director (Marketing) in Level 10 with five years' regular service and the prescribed qualifications will be considered along with outsiders; selection deemed promotion

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Office of the Jute Commissioner Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Departmental officers in the feeder category in direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation

content_sections.text: Deputation including short-term contract, with any preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years Terms of deputation governed by the normal terms and conditions for deputation issued by the Government of India from time to time

content_sections.text: Fill the application in triplicate in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I of the circular. Enclose cadre clearance, attested APAR photocopies of last 5 years, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance and penalty / No Penalty certificate. Get the application verified / countersigned by the Head of Office or an authorised officer and forwarded by the Cadre Controlling Authority. Send it through proper channel to the Deputy Jute Commissioner, Office of the Jute Commissioner, Patsan Bhawan, CF Block, 7th & 8th Floor, Action Area-1, Newtown, Kolkata-700 156. Subscribe the envelope "Application for the post Deputy Director (Marketing)". Application must be received within 17th November 2026; late, incomplete or applications without documents will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Office of the Jute Commissioner Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Office of the Jute Commissioner Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Deputy Director (Marketing).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Office of the Jute Commissioner Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I (Proforma) of this circular) and send it to Deputy Jute Commissioner, Office of the Jute Commissioner, Patsan Bhawan, CF Block, 7th & 8th Floor, Action Area-1, Newtown, Kolkata-700 156, by through proper channel, forwarded by the cadre controlling authority, to reach by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 11 of pay matrix, Rs. 67,700-2,08,700.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's Degree with Economics/Commerce/Business Studies/Statistics/Mathematics as main subject and five years' experience, or Master's Degree in these subjects with three years' experience, in work related to jute marketing or statistical analysis and research work in a Government organisation; plus analogous post on regular basis or five years' regular service in Level 10.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be holding an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service in Level 10 (56,100-1,77,500) or equivalent in parent cadre. Candidate must be able to be spared to take up the assignment within one month from the date of intimation about selection. Departmental Assistant Director (Marketing) in Level 10 with five years' regular service and the prescribed qualifications will be considered along with outsiders; selection deemed promotion.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category in direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment by the Selection Committee, which will also assess the proforma and documents submitted. The proforma, supported by the documents submitted, will also be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation including short-term contract, with any preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years. Terms of deputation governed by the normal terms and conditions for deputation issued by the Government of India from time to time.
